title: Add Fake-Multiplayer Ghost Drones & Speed Boost Rings
description: Spawn 2-3 AI rival ghost drones with floating player name tags and add golden speed-boost rings between pillars that grant +3 bonus points and brief invulnerability dash.

title: Add Cascade Combo Fever Bar & 2x Score Surge
description: Add a decaying combo fever bar to the top HUD that fills when consecutive 10-tile cascades trigger within 4 seconds; when full, activate Fever Mode with golden particle trails and 2x quota progress.

title: Add Acrylic Plate Raycast Occlusion Feedback & Orbit Hint
description: Include active non-falling plates in tap raycasting so tapping a screw covered by a front plate flashes the obstructing plate in red and displays a subtle 360-orbit hand prompt.

title: Add Translucent Slide Destination Ghost Preview & Gate Pulse
description: When a player grabs a polyomino block, highlight matching color shredder gates with a subtle scale pulse to improve instant visual readability.

title: Add Rapid-Clear Streak Counter & Ascending Audio Pitch
description: Track consecutive valid arrow block clears without a blocked bonk; display a floating streak badge (2x, 3x, 4x...) and ramp Web Audio synth pitch per streak step.
